scope: Vocabulary generation through the real plugin client; not Writing mode, UI interaction, Anki delivery, or a population-wide accuracy estimate.

manualReadyRubric.lemmaAndGrammar: 0 wrong lexical item/category; 1 partially correct/incomplete; 2 correct
manualReadyRubric.sourceMeaning: 0 wrong meaning; 1 partly correct/misleading boundary; 2 correct source meaning
manualReadyRubric.explanationAndNotes: 0 substantive false teaching; 1 minor overstatement or weak notes; 2 accurate/useful
manualReadyRubric.generalMeaningAndFormation: 0 false base relation/substantive error; 1 incomplete or minor error; 2 correct (empty formation acceptable)
manualReadyRubric.examples: 0 invented sense/seriously incorrect examples; 1 mostly useful but some category drift, overlap or awkward examples; 2 natural established usages of the requested lexical category

scoring: Manual assessment by the assistant; 0-2 per dimension, max 10 per ready case. Failed ready generations count as 0 for a usability-adjusted average. Repeat runs are assessed for consistency separately and excluded from primary quality averages. Uncertainty handling is separate. Automatic structural validation is not semantic accuracy.
